first_win.title: AMAZING! 🎉
first_win.subtitle: You completed your first level!
first_win.natural: ✨ You're a natural! Levels get more exciting ✨

intro.title: Score BIG points!
intro.body: Match 4 or more pieces in a row for a HUGE bonus. Chain combos as pieces fall to multiply your score up to x5!
intro.cascade: Cascades: x2, x3, x4, up to x5!

defeat.title: Tip for next time
defeat.body: Try to match 4 or 5 pieces in a row. Big matches score way more, and cascades multiply your points.

first_big.title: AMAZING!
first_big.body: You just made a MEGA combo! Keep it up to multiply your score.

tutorial.step1: Tap a tile, then an adjacent one to swap them. Match 3 or more identical tiles.
tutorial.step2: Keep going. Collect the objective tiles before running out of moves.

customize.title: Customize your tiles
customize.subtitle: Pick a photo for each tile type in the game.
customize.hint: Tap a slot to add or change the photo.
customize.permissionDenied: We need access to your photos to customize the tiles
customize.changeOrKeep: Do you want to change this photo?
customize.errorGeneric: Something went wrong with the image

update.required_message: A new version with important improvements is available. Please update from Google Play to continue playing.

customize_intro.title: Did you know you can put YOUR photos on the board?
customize_intro.body: Replace flowers with photos of your family, pets, or anything you love. It is free!

hammer.title: 🔨 Hammer
hammer.desc: Breaks any tile on the board. Tap the hammer, then the tile you want to remove.

shuffle.title: 🔀 Shuffle
shuffle.desc: Reorganizes all tiles on the board. Use it when you can't find a move.

change.title: 🔄 Change
change.desc: Transform a tile on the board into the icon you choose. Tap Change, then the tile, then the new icon.

undo.title: ↩️ Undo
undo.desc: Reverts your last move without losing the attempt.

matches.title: Match scoring
matches.hint: Bigger matches award more points and special bonuses.

combos.title: Cascading combos
combos.desc: When tiles fall and trigger more matches in a row, your score is multiplied:

powerups.title: Power-ups
powerups.change: Change — transforms 1 tile into the icon you pick
powerups.hint: If you don't have enough gems, you'll see a warning. Inventory power-ups are free.

objectives.title: Level types
objectives.collect: Collect: gather X tiles of a type
objectives.score: Score: reach X points before moves run out
objectives.bonus: Bonus: special levels with extra reward

themes.title: Themes and personalization
themes.desc: You can change the board icons (flowers, animals, fruits, desserts…) or put YOUR photos on each tile from the Customize section.

economy.title: Game economy
economy.piggy: Piggy bank: accumulates gems on losses; unlock it
economy.pass: Garden Pass: premium rewards for progressing
economy.streak: Daily streak: log in every day for bonuses

l1tut.welcome_body: Tap a tile, then an adjacent one to swap them. Match 3 or more identical tiles to collect them.
l1tut.perfect_body: Keep going. Collect the objective tiles before you run out of moves.
